description: Curated HAIQU question set stratified by target answer view. Each graph gets 18 questions: 3 ranking, 3 grouped_summary, 3 distribution, 3 comparison, 3 frontier, and 3 provenance. The goal is to test answer-view selection breadth rather than only top-k ranking.

questions.question: Which engineering controls have the broadest validation footprint across hospital zones? Return the top three item names as a comma-separated list with no explanation.
Which engineering controls most often combine pathogen-reduction evidence with low-cost proxies? Return the top three item names as a comma-separated list with no explanation.
Which engineering controls are most frequently linked to practical compliance evidence? Return the top three item names as a comma-separated list with no explanation.
Summarize the best-supported engineering controls by reported outcome. Return three records in the form 'control | outcome | support count'.
For engineering controls with validation support, summarize which adverse-effect or safety outcomes are reported. Return three records in the form 'control | outcome | support count'.
Summarize the strongest-supported controls by pathogen target. Return three records in the form 'control | pathogen or overall | support count'.
What is the distribution of validation-study support counts per engineering control? Return 'n=<n>; mean=<mean>; median=<median>'.
What is the distribution of adverse-effect support counts across engineering controls? Return 'n=<n>; mean=<mean>; median=<median>'.
What is the distribution of pathogen-target coverage per engineering control? Return 'n=<n>; mean=<mean>; median=<median>'.
Compare the two most-supported engineering controls on validation support and adverse-effect burden. Return one line per control.
Compare the two most-supported controls on compliance evidence and pathogen-target breadth. Return one line per control.
Compare the two most-supported controls on validation-study count and number of linked hospital zones. Return one line per control.
Which engineering controls lie on the tradeoff frontier between validation support and adverse-effect burden? Return up to five controls, comma-separated.
Which engineering controls lie on the tradeoff frontier between compliance evidence and pathogen-target breadth? Return up to five controls, comma-separated.
Which engineering controls lie on the tradeoff frontier between zone coverage and validation-study support? Return up to five controls, comma-separated.
